notes: Contraction of technology-replace-0002: removes the original fact, 'The World Wide Web was invented by Tim Berners-Lee' (invented_by). invented_by has no functional or cardinality:many tag in RELATIONS.md and an existing relation's tags cannot be changed from staging: see staging/technology-delete-abox.invented_by.PROPOSED.md (cardinality:many: a technology can have several inventors). Cardinality question: Tim Berners-Lee still invented HTML (another thing he invented, stored by name). Related near is the inverse; related far is the revision's own birth-country question through the description 'the inventor of the World Wide Web'. Derived: two compositions that look up a fact stored about Berners-Lee by name (his knighthood, his Oxford degree). The revision's Cerf, TCP/IP, Chief Internet Evangelist and W3C questions describe the new value or a world and are not reused; a question about CERN was avoided because the Web is itself stored as invented at CERN, a route around the removed fact. Evidence of the original fact and the birth-country fact is copied from the revision; new phrases are in count_requests.
